```js
await (async(page)=>{
const out=[];
for(const name of ['Forgot Password?','Sign Up','Official Login']){
await page.goto('https://apptourlfr-stg.estpl.net/home',{waitUntil:'load'});await page.locator('#otUserIconBtn').click();
const row={name,console:[],network:[]};const ce=m=>{if(m.type()==='error')row.console.push(m.text())},pe=e=>row.console.push(e.message),rf=r=>row.network.push({url:r.url(),error:r.failure()?.errorText}),rs=r=>{if(r.status()>=400)row.network.push({url:r.url(),status:r.status()})};
page.on('console',ce);page.on('pageerror',pe);page.on('requestfailed',rf);page.on('response',rs);
await page.getByRole('link',{name,exact:true}).click();await page.waitForTimeout(1200);
row.state=await page.evaluate(()=>({url:location.href,title:document.title,headings:[...document.querySelectorAll('h1,h2,h3')].filter(x=>x.checkVisibility()).map(x=>x.innerText),breadcrumbs:[...document.querySelectorAll('[class*="breadcrumb"]')].filter(x=>x.checkVisibility()).map(x=>x.innerText),broken:[...document.images].filter(x=>x.checkVisibility()&&x.complete&&!x.naturalWidth&&x.getAttribute('src')).map(x=>x.src),visibleText:document.body.innerText.slice(0,1200)}));
row.screenshot='manual_test_cases/odisha_evidence/account-final-'+name.replace(/[^a-z]/gi,'')+'.png';await page.screenshot({path:row.screenshot});
page.off('console',ce);page.off('pageerror',pe);page.off('requestfailed',rf);page.off('response',rs);out.push(row);
}await page.goto('https://apptourlfr-stg.estpl.net/home',{waitUntil:'load'});
await page.locator('#searchTriggerBtn').click();await page.locator('#closeSearchBtn').click();out.push({name:'Search close',inputVisible:await page.getByRole('textbox',{name:'search-bar'}).isVisible()});
await page.locator('.main-nav-fixed a[href="https://www.bookodisha.com/"]').click();await page.locator('#ext-modal-overlay').filter({visible:true}).locator('#ext-modal-cancel').click();out.push({name:'External cancel',url:page.url(),tabs:page.context().pages().length,modalVisible:await page.locator('#ext-modal-overlay').filter({visible:true}).count()});
return out;
})(page);
```
